properties.name: houtu.web.exception-resolver
properties.description: Whether to enable a unified exception resolver.

properties.name: houtu.web.exception-fallback
properties.description: Whether to wrap unknown exceptions into a unified fallback response. Disable on upstream services so unknown exceptions propagate and are surfaced by tracing.

properties.name: houtu.web.combine-form-resolver-type
properties.description: The processing method of composite parameter resolver for Form parameters.
